description: This file defines the LoanChargeCannotBePayedException class, which extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException, and includes an enum for reasons why a loan charge cannot be paid, along with methods to retrieve error messages and codes.

classes.name: LoanChargeCannotBePayedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a loan charge cannot be paid, with reasons enumerated in LoanChargeCannotBePayedReason.

classes.name: LoanChargeCannotBePayedReason
classes.description: Enum listing reasons why a loan charge cannot be paid, with methods to get corresponding error messages and codes.

methods.name: LoanChargeCannotBePayedException
methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with a specific reason and loan charge ID.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message based on the reason.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns an error code string based on the reason.
